WITH filtered_dates AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1189 + 11
),
store_seen AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer.c_last_name, customer.c_first_name, filtered_dates.d_date
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN filtered_dates ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = filtered_dates.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer ON store_sales.ss_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
),
catalog_seen AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer.c_last_name, customer.c_first_name, filtered_dates.d_date
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN filtered_dates ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = filtered_dates.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer ON catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
),
web_seen AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer.c_last_name, customer.c_first_name, filtered_dates.d_date
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN filtered_dates ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = filtered_dates.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer ON web_sales.ws_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
),
all_seen AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date FROM store_seen
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date FROM catalog_seen
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date FROM web_seen
)
SELECT count(*)
FROM (
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date
    FROM all_seen
    GROUP BY c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 3
) AS hot_cust
LIMIT 100
